## What you want

A new format reader, a new check rule, a query relation, or another capability.

## For a new format

- The format and a link to its spec, if public
- A sample export (a small, redistributable one is ideal)
- Whether you need netlist connectivity, faithful geometry, or both

## For a new check rule

- The design condition it should flag, in plain terms
- Why it matters (what fails if the condition is present)
- An example design that should fire it and one that should stay silent
